content.name: Ethan Cho
content.title: Junior UX Designer
content.summary: Junior UX designer with a UBC Cognitive Systems degree, a civic tech co-op term and two years designing patient-facing features for a telehealth start-up. Comfortable with research, Figma prototyping and accessibility basics; my redesigned appointment booking flow cut booking errors by 30%.

experience.title: UX Design Co-op
bullets: Interviewed 16 residents and front-desk staff about applying for a recreation fee subsidy online.
Designed and tested a shorter eligibility screener in Figma, reducing average completion time in tests from 9 minutes to 4.
Presented findings and a prototype to the partner municipality's digital team at the end of the term.

experience.title: Junior UX Designer
bullets: Design patient-facing features for a virtual clinic app used by about 45,000 British Columbians.
Reworked the appointment booking flow after five rounds of usability testing, cutting booking errors by about 30%.
Ran an accessibility review with screen reader users and fixed colour contrast and focus order issues across 20 screens.
Keep the Figma component library up to date and document each component's states for developers.

education.degree: BSc in Cognitive Systems (Cognition and Brain)

achievements.title: UBC design jam winner
achievements.detail: Team prototype for a campus food bank ordering app won first place in 2023.

achievements.title: Student design club
achievements.detail: Organized portfolio review nights for 60 students as club vice-president.
